<includeonly><infobox type="Character">
	<title source="name"/>
	<image source="image">
	    <caption source="imagecaption" />
	</image>
	<group>
	    <data source="aliases"><label>别名</label></data>
	    <data source="relatives"><label>亲属</label></data>
	    <data source="affiliation"><label>所属</label></data>
        <data source="occupation"><label>职业</label></data>
    </group>
    <group>
        <header>生平信息</header>
        <data source="marital"><label>婚姻状况</label></data>
    	<data source="birthDate"><label>出生日期</label></data>
        <data source="birthPlace"><label>出生地</label></data>
        <data source="deathDate"><label>死亡日期</label></data>
        <data source="deathPlace"><label>死亡地点</label></data>
    </group>
    <group>
        <header>生理特征</header>
        <data source="species"><label>物种</label></data>
        <data source="gender"><label>性别</label></data>
        <data source="height"><label>身高</label></data>
        <data source="weight"><label>体重</label></data>
        <data source="eyes"><label>瞳色</label></data>
	</group>
    <group>
       <header>登场信息</header>
       <data source="portrayedby"><label>饰演者</label></data>
       <data source="appearsin"><label>登场作品</label></data>
       <data source="debut"><label>首次登场</label></data>
    </group>
</infobox>{{#ifeq: {{NAMESPACENUMBER}} | 0 | [[Category:Characters]]}}</includeonly><noinclude>{{Documentation}}</noinclude>
